texts.value: Serves as the first electron transfer protein in all the mitochondrial P450 systems including cholesterol side chain cleavage in all steroidogenic tissues, steroid 11-beta hydroxylation in the adrenal cortex, 25-OH-vitamin D3-24 hydroxylation in the kidney, and sterol C-27 hydroxylation in the liver (By similarity). Also acts as a ferredoxin--NADP(+) reductase essential for coenzyme Q biosynthesis: together with FDX2, transfers the electrons required for the hydroxylation reaction performed by COQ6 (PubMed:38425362)

disease.description: An autosomal recessive disease characterized by hearing loss, visual impairment and optic atrophy, with onset in the first or second decades of life. Optic atrophy is caused by degeneration of nerve fibers which arise in the retina and converge to form the optic disk, optic nerve, optic chiasm and optic tracts.
